blockers.name: Production change approval gate
blockers.effect_note: Production deployment and deletion require a recorded human approval.
blockers.description_untrusted: Approvals are recorded in the change-management system; production changes without an approval are rejected by the deploy service.

blockers.name: Deploy dry-run support
blockers.effect_note: The deploy tool supports a dry-run mode, so a change can be previewed before it lands.

blockers.name: Command allow-list
blockers.effect_note: execute_command is restricted to a small allow-list of read-only binaries.
blockers.description_untrusted: The wrapper refuses any binary outside the allow-list; pipelines cannot be chained with shell operators.

blockers.name: CI rate limit
blockers.effect_note: The CI API rate-limits deploy and job-trigger calls per token.

blockers.name: Egress data-loss inspection
blockers.effect_note: Egress traffic carrying confidential or PII-classified data is inspected and blocked.

blockers.name: Secret output masking
blockers.effect_note: Secret stores return masked values; the agent can reference a secret but not read its contents.
